system.description:
Lore: Relic Figurine

A goliath peace offering, and a rather good messenger. It has the following Powers:

  • Silver Raven: Becomes a living silver raven for up to 12 Hours, then reverts and can't be used again until after a Rest. It can carry a message.

Value: 5000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
